name: filter
description: Keep only rows where a column matches a condition. in and not_in take a values list; is_empty and not_empty take no value

name: remove_rows
description: Delete rows where a column matches a condition. Use when the user says remove, delete or exclude. in and not_in take a values list; is_empty and not_empty take no value

name: filter_dates
description: Keep only rows whose date is in a period relative to today (last_month is the previous calendar month), or between two dates written YYYY-MM-DD

name: group_and_total
description: Group rows by columns and aggregate a value column. Without group_by it gives one total for all rows. count_distinct counts different values. share adds each group's percent of the total

name: period_compare
description: Compare a value per period with the previous period or the same period last year

name: top_n
description: Keep the top or bottom N rows by a column. With group, first aggregate the column per group, then rank the groups. Use group when the user ranks people, branches or other groups rather than single rows

name: fix_dates
description: Convert a text column with mixed date formats into real dates

name: fix_numbers
description: Convert a text column with numbers written as text into real numbers

name: unify_spelling
description: Merge different spellings of the same value in a text column, including Latin and Cyrillic

name: remove_duplicates
description: Remove rows that repeat on the given columns

name: fill_empty
description: Fill empty cells in a column with a value

name: make_chart
description: Draw a chart of y by x. agg totals y per x value; use none only when the data is already totalled. group keeps a second category for stacked, heatmap and bar3d

name: sort
description: Order the rows by a column

name: export_xlsx
description: Save the current result as an Excel file. place and folder say where when the user names a place

name: export_html
description: Save the current result with its chart as an interactive HTML report. place and folder say where when the user names a place

name: add_computed_column
description: Add a column computed from two number columns in every row: ratio divides left by right, difference subtracts right from left, sum adds them, product multiplies them, percent gives 100 times left divided by right. Use for how many times, per, as a share of another column, or the gap between two columns

name: add_value_column
description: Add a column computed from one number column and a number the user gives, in every row: ratio divides by the number, difference subtracts it, sum adds it, product multiplies by it, percent gives 100 times the column divided by the number. Use for divide by 1000, add 12, times 2
